CRT-131.description:
h2. Requirements

Epic to fix liquidation statuses in Web Broker according to Corner functionality:
 # Distinguish automatic and manual liquidation: [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-412] 
 # Show only liquidation orders that are available in Corner: Manual, Margin Utilization

Show new message for manual liquidation in dxTrade: [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-411] 
h2. Scenarios
 # Make an automatic Liquidation happen on account (increase margin utilization) -> See Order book in Web Broker, column "Liquidation" should be filled with "Margin Utilization" for liquidation orders
 # Execute manual liquidation on account via Account List in WB
 ## -> see Notification in dxTrade according to [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-411] 
 ## -> See Order book in Web Broker, column "Liquidation" should be filled with "Manual" for liquidation orders
 # Execute usual order from account -> See Order book in Web Broker, column "Liquidation" should be not be filled for this order
 # Check filter for column "Liquidation" -> it should contain only 2 values: "Manual" and "Margin Utilization", these values should be according to the new associated data setting webBrokerSupportedLiquidationRules@PreciseCalibrationDomain
 # optionally: check that product works the same way as before: all the previous values according to [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/DR/WEBBROKER-120] should be in new setting webBrokerSupportedLiquidationRules@PreciseCalibrationDomain and be shown in WB

CRT-303.description:
h2. Requirements:
 # Absolute net exposure calculation is moved from [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-865] to [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-981] (not shown in UIs)
 # Introduce Exposure Coverage metric: [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-982] (show in dxTrade, in %)
 # Show Exposure Coverage metric in WB: [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-991]  (add filter and sorting)
 # Add Exposure Coverage in EOD report: [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-992] 

 
h4. Scenario:
 # Net exposure:
The account has no orders and positions. Portfolio value = Account value. Open a position on Futures ZL Sep 25*10, ZL OCT 25*3, and create a limit order that won't be filled.
Calculate the Absolute Net exposure manually: sum of all Instrument exposure on open positions:  (10*49,36 * 600)+ (3 * 49,36 *600) =  385008
 # Exposure coverage: 
After Scenario 1, see the portfolio equity. The Portfolio’s Exposure coverage should be equal to the result of “Equity / Absolute net exposure * 100%”: 121453/ 385008 *100  = 31,54= 32.00%
Compare with Exposure coverage metric in Portfolio Metrics.
Buy ZL Sep 25*2, see the Exposure coverage metric decreased.
 # Exposure coverage metric in WB:
 ## Go to WB, click on the “Account list” widget. In the list of columns see “Exposure coverage”. In list of filters there is filter “Exposure coverage”. Once the column title clicked, the sorting happens.
 ## Open the Client Area -> “Portfolio overview” widget. See the metric there.
 # Exposure coverage in EOD report:
Request the "EODPortfolioMetrics" report. See there is exposure_coverage metric filled with value in scenario 2 in decimal format.

CRT-367.summary: Client Area Improvements - Add Risk Profile to Client Area and Remove Terminated Accounts
CRT-367.description:
h2. Requirements:
 # Hide TERMINATED and simulated accounts from account selector in client area: [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1144] 
 # Add Risk Profile to client area: [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1145] . Note that it should build portfolio same way as in dxtrade (through all accounts)

h3. Scenarios:
h4. Scenario 1. Hide Terminated and Simulated accounts from the account selector

Pre-condition:

A user with multiple accounts:
 # at least 1 is active,
 # 1 simulated and
 # 1 to be terminated accounts.

h4. Scenario 1.1. Terminated account
 # Prepare:
 ** there is a trader user with 2 accounts (“test_tatiana_USD” and “test_tatiana_EUR”)
 # Log in as webbroker. See that the 2 accounts available in the account selector.
 # Go to Accounts list, find the user (e.g. “test_tatiana”) and the account (“test_tatiana_EUR”)), set “Terminated” and save changes.
 # ** Result: **
 ** Check the accounts dropdown: there is no account that has been terminated (e.g. there is 1 account remaining, the “test_tatiana_USD”)
 ** The trader does not see the terminated account.

h4. Scenario 1.2 Simulated account
 # Prepare:
 ** there is a an account (“test_tatiana_USD”) with an order (e.g. TSLA Call option 250411C170 of ‘buy to Open” side) in “analyze” mode.
 # Log in as web broker. In the account selector enter the first 8 symbols account (in this case “test_tat”) and see the list of available accounts.
 # ** Result: **
 ** There are only the active accounts which start with the input string (in this case, “test_tatiana_USD” and “test_tatiana_EUR”).
 ** There is no simulated accounts in the list.

h4. Scenario 2. Add Risk Profile added to Client area

Pre-condition:

A user with multiple accounts:
 # “test_tatiana_USD”, “test_tatiana_EUR” - each have open position of 1 TSLA:xnas call option;
 # “test_tatiana_EUR” has 1 TSLA:xnas stock
 # another user with active account (e.g “ana” account)

CRT-455.summary: Adding new metrics to DXSCA-WEB API for Cornèr Invest
CRT-455.description:
* Metrics endpoints in DXSCA should be changed according to spec: [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1215]
** Only metrics listed in SPEC should be returned for Corner. Other BRO metrics should not be returned
** Metrics are calculated with assumption that {{One Portfolio == One Account}}. That means that such metrics should be calculated only for Account. Not for whole portfolio. 
* New component {{metrics-publisher-delayed}} should be added to the platform https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1217
** The component should calculate metrics only by Delayed prices
** The component should calculate metrics only for accounts marked with {{enableMetricsInRestApi=true}}
* New Boolean flag {{enableMetricsInRestApi}} is added to account https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1216
** It's supported in Onboarding and  Account Updated REST API
* Update Validate Order endpoint: https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1221
** Return Validation details: https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1222

h2. Requirements:

!image-2025-08-28-13-43-19-238.png!


 * Explain margin should always show dissection by strategies formed on portfolio level (not account level): e.g. if there is AAPL option on acc 1 and AAPL option on acc 2, click on any of these positions should open underlying margin explanation on portfolio level: both positions will be shown. It should already work as is, as we core should calculate margin only on portfolio level, but should be double validated.

CRT-638.summary: Add FX Spot to instrument suggestion
CRT-638.description:
*Context*

New instrument type FX_SPOT should appear in instrument suggestion.

*Acceptance Criteria*

Given the User is in the widget where search is available
When the User types any symbol
Then relevant instruments including FX_Spot are displayed in the tab 'All'
And only FX_Spot instruments are displayed in the tab 'FX Spot'.  

 

Given the User is in the widget where column filters are available
When the User filters by instrument type/instrument/symbol
Then Forex type and FX_Spot instruments are available in the filters. 

*Requirements*

1. Add FX_SPOT to instrument suggestion by:
 * Including it in the ‘All’ tab - see [CRT-1745|https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1745] 

 * Creating a new tab labeled ‘FX Spot’ - see [CRT-1744|https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1744] 

2. Check that FX_Spot appears in the column filter by instrument type and FX_Spot instruments - in filters by symbol and instrument in all related widgets.

CRT-642.description:
*Context*
There is freeze period when prices are not available due to ET system reload:
 * 17:00 - 17:15 NY during week: Mon-Thu.

This period is included in non-trading hours in instrument schedule. During non-trading hours the platform behavior should be defined.

*Acceptance Criteria for web*

Given the User is on the web 
When the User tries to issue a *new order* for FX_SPOT during non-trading hours
Then the User is able to send an order 
But the order is rejected with the appropriate reason displayed on the order entry form itself if it's OTC Order Entry or confirmation screen if it's a regular order entry. 

Given the User is on the web 
When the User tries to *modify* FX_SPOT order during non-trading hours
Then the User is able to send an order 
But the order is rejected with the appropriate reason displayed on the order entry form itself if it's OTC Order Entry or confirmation screen if it's a regular order entry. 

Given the User is on the web 
When the User tries to *cancel* FX_SPOT order during non-trading hours
Then the User is able to confirm cancellation (assuming all other conditions are met)
But the action is rejected with the appropriate reason. 

Given the User is on the web 
When the User tries to *close FX_SPOT position* during non-trading hours
Then the User is able to send an order 
But the order is rejected with the appropriate reason displayed on the order entry form itself if it's OTC Order Entry or confirmation screen if it's a regular order entry. 

Given the User is on the Watchlist
When the User is *viewing quotes* for FX_SPOT during non-trading hours
Then the User sees them greyed out.

*Acceptance Criteria for adaptive*

Given the User is on the adaptive
When the User tries to issue a *new order* for FX_SPOT during non-trading hours
Then the User is able to send an order 
But the order is rejected with the appropriate reason displayed on the order entry form.

CRT-671.summary: Change order status from ACCEPTED to SENDING
CRT-671.description:
*Business Context*

At 'ACCEPTED" dxCore status order is not confirmed by the executor yet. 'Sending' instead of 'Working' on UI will be a clearer status, especially for trading with ET.

*Requirements*

If dxCore order status is 'ACCEPTED', status 'Sending' should be displayed on UI:
 * web
 * webbroker
 * adaptive

In Adaptive the orders with the status 'Sending' that is to be shown on UI should be displayed in the list 'Working orders' on the 'Portfolio' tab and 'Account' page. 

See [CRT-1902|https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1902] in updated order statuses table [CRT-1726.|https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1726]

*Scenarios*

1. Issue an order.

2. When order status in dxCore is 'ACCEPTED',

check its naming on UI:  in web/webbroker/adaptive. It should be displayed as 'Sending'. 

check that the order is displayed in the list 'Working orders' on the 'Portfolio' tab and 'Account' page.
